title: Gorgeous 3BR Rosemary Beach Cottage with a Private Pool
meta_description: A charming Cottage and Carriage House with a private pool and courtyard in the heart of iconic Rosemary Beach
description_expanded: DescriptionDiscover Your Perfect Getaway!Escape to Hazel's Cottage and Carriage House, an enchanting cottage in Rosemary Beach, ideal for your next serene retreat. This gorgeous home features elegant interiors, a private pool (heating available to purchase), two outdoor showers, a carriage house, and ample accommodations for up to 12 guests. **Indoor and outdoor fireplaces are decoration only**Step inside to find a beautifully furnished living area with plush furniture, perfect for cozy movie nights in front of the flat-screen TV above the fireplace. The stunning kitchen is equipped for culinary delights, boasting stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops. Enjoy meals together at the dining table or the breakfast bar with seating for four.The second floor offers two bedrooms: a primary suite with a king bed and private bathroom, and a guestroom with two full beds. Additionally, there’s a bunk area with a twin-over-twin bunk bed. Guests in the guestroom and bunk area share a bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The carriage house provides extra guest accommodations, featuring a plush California king bed, a kitchenette, a twin trundle bed, and a bathroom with a spacious glass-front double-rain head shower and a dual-sink vanity.Enjoy the Florida sunshine by the private, sparkling pool, which can be heated seasonally for an additional fee. The home is also equipped with four custom 30A Luxury bikes, perfect for exploring the best local dining, shopping, and entertainment in Rosemary Beach, Seaside, and along the 30A coastal towns—or for cruising over to the sugar-white sandy beach! Guests also have access to four beautiful community pools, perfect for hours of relaxation and fun.Don’t miss out on this exquisite Rosemary Beach cottage!HOME HIGHLIGHTS* Clean Bedding Program* 4 Complimentary Adult Beach Cruiser Bikes* Sonos Sound System* Private courtyard* Courtyard with private pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)* Propane Grill* Separate Carriage House (guest house above garage)FISRT FLOOR* Living room, dining area, and KitchenSECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with ShowerGuest Bedroom: Two Full Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/ Tub ComboBunk Area: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/ Tub ComboCARRIAGE HOUSE:Guest Bedroom: Twin Trundle Bed, Shared Bathroom with Double Rainhead ShowerLiving Space: California King Bed
